name: Harbor Cove Cafe
bio: Harbor Cove Cafe is an island-themed, dog-friendly cafe on Spinnaker Drive at Ventura Harbor, serving breakfast, lunch, dinner and tropical drinks. It has been open under its current name since 2005 and hosts live music.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from harborcovecafe.net, @harborcovecafe and the cafe's Facebook.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
